name: stroke-text
title: Stroke Text
description: Outlined text that fills on hover from configurable directions, with optional character-by-character stagger.

changelog.summary: Restored the default fontWeight prop value to 700.
Switched to a flat background color and made reduced-motion fill apply instantly.

props.name: variant
props.description: Direction or shape used for the fill reveal.

props.name: characterFill
props.description: Reveals the fill character by character on hover.

props.name: fillColor
props.description: Color that fills the text on hover.

props.name: characterStagger
props.description: Delay between each character fill step.
